notes: Original offer document (SC TO-I with Offer to Purchase, seq 2) for a non-traded BDC ('elected to be regulated as a business development company'; 'there is otherwise no public market for the Shares'), so no ticker. price_pct_nav=100: the price is stated as 'equal to the net asset value per Share as of May 31, 2021', not as a percent; note the NAV date (May 31, 2021) falls AFTER the expiration (May 17, 2021). size_shares 390,941 is an ESTIMATE: the offer is sized as the Shares purchasable with 90% of DRIP proceeds from the April 1, 2021 dividend, and the count depends on the Purchase Price (390,941 assumes the December 31, 2020 NAV of $7.28; transaction valuation $2,846,049.40). size_pct_outstanding is not stated (80,099,885 Shares outstanding as of April 12, 2021; 390,941 / 80,099,885 would be about 0.49%, my arithmetic, not entered). The programme caps quarterly tenders at the lesser of DRIP proceeds and 2.5% of the weighted average outstanding Shares in the prior four quarters. The offer is expressly NOT conditioned on a minimum tender and 'not subject to any financing condition'. Conditions mapping (Section 3): legal action challenging the Offer -> legal_injunction; banking moratorium / credit limitation / war -> market_disruption; any other event that in the Board's judgment would have a material adverse effect -> board_discretion; purchase causing a violation of US or other laws -> other. RIC qualification appears only as a factor the Board considered, not as a condition, so ric_or_tax_status is not listed. Commencement date is the date of the Offer to Purchase (also the SC TO-I filing date, April 12, 2021). Odd-lot priority applies under proration.
